## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The legacy fetcher’s retry limit should be reduced because eight attempts violate the existing three-attempt policy and prolong outage waits.

## Changes
The pull request adds inventory fetch and health helpers with retry handling and parameterized tests. It also adds a legacy-module exemption to the retry documentation.

## Important
- app/legacy/fetch.py:18 — correctness — Cap legacy inventory retries at three attempts — When the legacy endpoint repeatedly times out, this loop makes eight attempts, violating `docs/review-rules.md:5`: “Code that retries a network call must stop after at most 3 attempts.” — During an inventory outage, callers perform five excess requests, keeping worker threads occupied through additional timeouts and sleeps.
